detail: research_observer failed 3x with API 529 (server overload) before doing any work. Observable trace (git baseline, commands.jsonl, run dirs with mtimes) is durable on disk, so a delayed observer can still audit the full process. Will keep retrying between benchmarks; deviation disclosed here and in final report.
risk: observer did not capture live pre-benchmark baseline itself; mitigated by primary's git_status_baseline.txt + append-only logs it can verify independently

decision: audit incident: B7 rerun overwrote B1 run directory
detail: Engine derives run_id from date+slug(topic); B7 reused B1 topic per plan, engine silently replaced B1 deep-run artifacts with B7 quick-run artifacts. B1 evidence was captured in benchmarks/B1/notes.md and commands.jsonl BEFORE overwrite. Kept as-is (no re-run) because regeneration cannot reproduce identical web content and the overwrite is itself primary evidence for the run-versioning gap.
risk: B1 raw bundle no longer on disk; analysis relies on contemporaneous notes
